items.title: Store Recalls Report Finds Walmart Named in 81 Official U.S. Recalls in 2026, More Than Any Other Physical Retailer
items.summary: Store Recalls, a free website that sorts official U.S. recalls by the store named in each notice, found that Walmart was named in 81 recalls between January 1 and November 10, 2026, more than any other physical retailer. Target followed with 25 notices and Costco with 19, according to the Store Recalls retailer recall report.
